## Summary

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link relevant epics/sprints, designs, named specification sections, and
execution plan when applicable. Note public API, compatibility, and artifact-content changes.

## Validation

Record exact commands and results, including `mvn clean install` for coding changes. Account for skipped tests, missing
coverage/check evidence, and remaining blockers. Link performance records for relevant hot-path changes.

## Documentation

Identify updated specifications, designs, examples, diagnostics, and planning evidence where relevant. Human
contributors need not follow the agent conversation sequence; observable acceptance evidence is what matters.
